purpose: Teach: バリー/メアリー/ラッセル/ジェリー/エド/エドワード/ブラッド/アニー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国コメディアンのバリー氏のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned that the customer is a fan of American comedian Barry.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Slight pause before the name, like she's recalling a detail. Gentle delivery, almost thinking aloud. Soft eye contact across the counter.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国シスター メアリーの自伝を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said the customer was reading a memoir by British Sister Mary.
lines.style: Light, observant tone. A small smile in the voice — noticing something endearing about the customer's reading taste. Unhurried, genuinely curious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国哲学者ラッセルの著作がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi tells me the customer loves the work of British philosopher Russell.
lines.style: Impressed, slightly delighted tone. A lift in the voice on 'philosopher.' Leaning into the detail like she's sharing something precious. Genuinely engaged.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国アニメのトムとジェリーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said the customer is a fan of the American cartoon Tom and Jerry.
lines.style: Soft, almost amused. A gentle warmth — the kind of moment when you notice someone has a childlike joy. Unhurried pacing, genuine affection in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国のエド・シーランのライブに行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned the customer went to an Ed Sheeran concert in the UK.
lines.style: Reflective, with a touch of wistfulness. Slight emphasis on 'went' — noticing something the customer experienced. Warm but thoughtful, like she's imagining it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国エドワード・ホッパーの画集を愛されてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi tells me the customer really loves Edward Hopper's artwork.
lines.style: Steady, appreciative tone. A gentle emphasis on 'loves' — recognizing genuine passion. Thoughtful delivery, like she's cataloging something important about this person.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国のブラッド・ピットの映画がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi says the customer is a fan of American actor Brad Pitt's films.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact with underlying warmth. No judgment, just noticing. Straightforward delivery, the tone of someone who accepts all kinds of tastes without ranking them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国ミュージカルのアニーがお好きだって、メイちゃん

lines.style: Soft, final reflection. Slight warmth and a hint of a smile. Trailing gently, as if this detail completes a small portrait she's been painting. Close and intimate.
